info.title: Inventory Search
info.description:
Retrieve inventory information for multiple products or SKUs.
**Note**:

* Searches can be based on either product IDs or SKU IDs, not both at the same time.
* Passing Product IDs returns the inventory information of all SKUs under the specified products.
* Passing SKU IDs returns the inventory information for the specified SKUs.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

product_ids.description:
A list of product IDs used to search for inventory information.
Max IDs: 100

sku_ids.description:
A list of SKU IDs used to search for inventory information.
Max IDs: 600

**Note**: If both `sku_ids` and `product_ids` are passed, `sku_ids` will take precedence.

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

product_id.description: The ID of the requested product.

id.description: The SKU ID generated by TikTok Shop.

seller_sku.description: An internal code/name for managing SKUs, not visible to buyers.

total_available_quantity.description:
The total number of units available for ordering across all warehouses.
It is the sum of the `warehouse_inventory.available_quantity` values in all warehouses.

total_committed_quantity.description:
The total number of units reserved by existing customer orders across all warehouses (and therefore not available for ordering).
It is the sum of the `warehouse_inventory.committed_quantity` values in all warehouses.

warehouse_id.description:
The ID of the warehouse where the SKU is stored. 
Retrieve details of the warehouse from the  [Get Warehouse List API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650aa418defece02be6e66b6).

available_quantity.description:
The total number of units available for ordering in this warehouse.
This is equivalent to the `inventory.quantity` value returned in the [Get Product API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6509d85b4a0bb702c057fdda).

committed_quantity.description: The total number of units reserved by existing customer orders in this warehouse (and therefore not available for ordering).

campaign_name.description: The name of the associated campaign.

campaign_inventory.description: Inventory that is allocated to a specific campaign.

creator_name.description: The name of the associated TikTok creator.

creator_inventory.description: Inventory that is allocated to TikTok creators.

in_shop_inventory.description: The remaining inventory available for the shop after deducting those allocated for campaigns and creators.

total_available_inventory_distribution.description: The distribution of the total available inventory for the SKU across different channels.

inventory.description: Inventory information for the requested products or SKUs.
